source.rationale: New change-type category: the SIGNATURE shape is completely unchanged (same param name, same type) -- only the default value moved (3 -> 5). This is easy to under-diff with any check that only looks at parameter names/types (Engineering Decision Log Entry 20's change_type classification is signature-vs-body; a default-only change is neither an addition, removal, nor a body change in the usual sense, and it's untested whether it's even classified as a diff-worthy change at all).

labels.notes_for_labeler: CONFIRMED (real run). Resolves the open question from the pre-run notes: a default-value-only change (signature shape unchanged) DOES reach the Verifier and get correctly flagged and fixed -- the concern that Entry 20's signature-vs-body change_type classifier might silently filter this out was unfounded, at least for this simple case. Clean proposed/approved, single-token old_text ('3'). Minor fragility note: a single-character old_text span is more collision-prone in general (would break if '3' appeared elsewhere in doc_section) -- not an issue here, but worth being aware of for future default-value cases in less controlled doc content.
